title: block-noncanonical-commit telemetry data
description: Per-hook `data` payload for the block-noncanonical-commit guard. Discovered from the envelope `hook` value "block-noncanonical-commit". Evolves additive-only. Carries NO full command string or commit message body.

tool.description: Always "Bash" — this guard matches only Bash tool calls.

subject.description: Privacy-safe command subject `Bash:<first-token>` with leading sudo / env-assignment prefixes stripped and the token basenamed. NEVER the full command or its arguments.

form.description: The non-canonical commit-message form when blocked (e.g. "message-flag" for a bare -m/-F not paired with the canonical marker). Empty string when the command was allowed (status ok).
